editorial:
Imagine you are at a fancy party celebrating 25 years of marriage. Everything looks perfect until your son walks in with a new girlfriend who has a serious grudge against you. That is exactly how things kick off here. You get to meet Ellen and Paul, a couple who seem to have it all, and Liz, a former student of Ellen's. Years ago, Ellen embarrassed Liz in front of the whole class for her radical beliefs, and Liz has not forgotten it. The vibe starts out polite but quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse. You can feel the tension building in every room as Liz slowly starts to tear the family apart from the inside.

What really works here is the acting, as the lead actors make the awkwardness feel totally real. The pacing is steady, though some might find the middle a bit slow before the big payoff. If you love movies where a secret guest ruins a dinner party, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist where Liz reveals she never actually loved Josh. She only dated him to get close to Ellen for revenge. In the final scene, Liz traps Ellen and forces her to admit her mistakes on a live stream. The family falls apart as secrets come out, and Liz walks away victorious, leaving Ellen's reputation and her marriage in total ruins. It is a cold ending that shows how a small grudge can grow into something deadly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and family secrets.
